Anybody can mint a receipt or an acknowledgement under it, so a `key_source` of `pinned` says only that the signature matched a key everyone holds. Replacing the placeholder with the real organiser key is the release gate before any entry is judged. Reported at Pass because this run was made with `--dev`, where the placeholder is the expected anchor — the sentence stays in the document so a reader can tell this verdict from a strict one
